title: Printing User Input
prompt:
Create a program that takes user input and prints it back to the console.
Sample Input: Hello, World!
Sample Output: Hello, World!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a simple program in Python that meets your requirements:

```python
# Get user input
user_input = input("Enter some text: ")

# Print the user input back to the console
print(user_input)
```

When you run this program, it will prompt the user to enter some text. Once the user enters their text and presses Enter, the program will print that text back to the console. Here's an example of how it might look:

```
Enter some text: Hello, World!
Hello, World!
```
